text:
rachel_finance: Flagging Klara Health dispute for INV-2026-09. Customer says they were charged $2,200 in burst fees on Sep 9 but that we had a partial outage causing retries.

tom_sales: Klara has Dedicated commit = $10,800/mo (3xA100 equiv). They saw a spike during a deploy window; burst shows ~3.6 hours used.

mei_csm: CASE-15220: https://redwood.at/support/CASE-15220 attached. Customer logs show 5xx and retries 02:05-05:50 UTC, degraded tails until 06:15. They're asking for fee removal or SLA credit.

ops_sam: Infra telemetry: rolling deploy led to a routing hiccup at 02:03; measured partial degradation = 3.2h. Root cause: deploy ordering bug; PR: https://github.com/redwood/deploy/pull/6491. Ops owns the failure.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-09: Reserved commit = $10,800; Burst/overage = $2,200; SLA credit = $0; Total = $13,000.

rachel_finance: SLA table: "Partial degradation >=3h and <6h -> 15% credit of monthly fee." 15% of $10,800 = $1,620. Options: (A) Apply SLA credit $1,620 only -> invoice = $11,380 (keep overage). (B) Waive overage $2,200 + apply SLA credit $1,620 = total concession $3,820 -> invoice = $9,180. Waiver is a write-off; need RevOps approval for B.

tom_sales: Customer wants the overage removed; they said our failover amplified retries. They also asked for a short note for their finance team.

ops_sam: I'll add a one-line RCA to CASE-15220 and link the fix. Ops recommends option B to preserve relationship.

ken_revops: I can approve up to $4k concessions if ops provides RCA. This fits. Approving Option B. Please record: concession_type=one_time_writeoff; waived_overage=$2,200; sla_credit=$1,620; total_concession=$3,820.

rachel_finance: Approved by RevOps. I'll create credit memo CM-2026-089 and corrected invoice INV-2026-09-C, update AR, and send a draft note: "Thanks for flagging 1 we've applied a $3,820 concession (SLA credit + one-time waiver) and issued a corrected invoice INV-2026-09-C. We're sorry for the disruption; ops has provided an RCA and a fix." Posting for sign-off.

mei_csm: LGTM. I'll offer Klara a 30-day complimentary burst buffer in the reply.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-089 created. Corrected invoice INV-2026-09-C issued.

mei_csm: Customer replied: "Thanks, we appreciate the quick handling and the buffer. Please share the RCA when ready." :thumbsup:
